1. `jit graph deps --json` still violates the list/query envelope requirement. In [crates/jit/src/main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:3613), the response is `GraphDepsTreeResponse { issue_id, depth, tree, summary }`; the collection is `tree`, and there is no top-level `count` equal to `tree.len()` nor a collection-typed envelope key. The command is part of the graph query family and emits a collection, so REQ-01 is not met. Its help also omits the required envelope statement at [crates/jit/src/cli.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/cli.rs:1734), so REQ-02 is not met.

2. `jit gate status-all --json` still emits multiple collection fields without the required list envelope. [crates/jit/src/output.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/output.rs:1267) defines `GateCheckAllResponse` with `results`, `not_run`, and `gate_statuses`, but no `count`; [crates/jit/src/main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:3098) serializes that shape directly. `total` is the number of required gates, not the envelope `count` for a single collection. This is a read-only gate query/report command that emits collections, so REQ-01 is not met.

3. `jit gate status --all/--limit --json` has an envelope in code (`results` plus `count`) but the envelope is not stated in command help or the CLI reference. The help only says the history view “lists prior runs” and every view supports JSON at [crates/jit/src/cli.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/cli.rs:1404), and the reference usage/options likewise omit the `{"count": N, "results": [...]}` contract at [docs/reference/cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:1419). This violates REQ-02.

4. The CLI reference still contradicts the new multi-id `issue show --json` shape. The example was updated to `{"count":2,"issues":[...]}`, but the flag rules still say “returns a JSON array” at [docs/reference/cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:1097). This violates REQ-02 and leaves a migration-contract footgun in the primary reference.
